title: Tell Me About Yourself
question: So, tell me a little bit about yourself — your family, where you live, whatever feels natural to share.
answer: Discussion question — there is no single correct answer. Assess warmth, openness and specific detail, not content.
modelReasoningPath: What to listen for: specific, concrete detail (names, places, particular family members or routines) versus a generic one-line answer. Note anything specific enough to come back to later — a sibling's name, a pet, a place they live, a hobby they mention in passing.
